events.title: Magellan's ships enter the Pacific
events.description: After 38 days navigating the strait at the tip of South America, Ferdinand Magellan's three remaining ships reached the open ocean. He named it the Pacific for its calm waters.
events.html: After 38 days navigating the strait at the tip of South America, Ferdinand Magellan's three remaining ships reached the open ocean. He named it the Pacific for its calm waters.

events.title: Arthur Griffith launches Sinn Féin's policy
events.description: At a convention in Dublin, Arthur Griffith set out the Sinn Féin policy, meaning 'we ourselves', of Irish self-reliance and a separate Irish parliament. The movement later became central to the struggle for independence.

events.title: Albania declares independence
events.description: In Vlorë, Ismail Qemali raised the Albanian flag and proclaimed independence from the Ottoman Empire during the First Balkan War. The great powers recognised the new state the following year.
events.html: In Vlorë, Ismail Qemali raised the Albanian flag and proclaimed independence from the Ottoman Empire during the First Balkan War. The great powers recognised the new state the following year.

events.title: Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin meet in Tehran
events.description: The 'Big Three' met together for the first time at the Tehran Conference. They committed to a cross-Channel invasion of France in 1944 and discussed the shape of post-war Europe.
